diagnosis.purpose: Identify safety issues in the actual reactor state

strategy_inventory.purpose: List valid mitigation strategies for a given reactor state
features: Matches predefined strategies to the provided state
limitations: Only lists strategies, does not make recommendations

prognosis.purpose: Forecast the reactor state given a certain action is taken
limitations: Only lists the prognosed states, does not make recommendations

strategy_assessment.purpose: Rank strategies for a given reactor state
features: Compares predicted outcomes from available strategies

updater_helper.purpose: Asks operator which action to take, then executes the desired action and updates the nuclear reactor state
features: Updates the reactor state with chosen action

summarizer.purpose: Summarizes the gathered data to give an answer to the user.
limitations: Relies entirely on the outputs of other agents

scenario_builder.purpose: Temporarily override the reactor state with hypothetical values.
features: Applies hypothetical overrides to the current reactor state
Updates the safety issues to match the overriden reactor state
Outputs the modified state for further analysis
limitations: Never alters the real reactor state
